metadata.title: Repository metadata review
metadata.description: Review version-control metadata at the root of a scanned project. History in these folders can be the only copy of commits, stashes and branches that were never pushed.

insights.title: Review Git repository history
insights.subject: repository
insights.detail: This folder is the repository. Unpushed commits, stashes, reflog entries and branches exist only here. Check git status and git log --branches --not --remotes before any change, and use git's own commands.

insights.title: Review Mercurial repository history
insights.subject: repository
insights.detail: Mercurial revisions and bookmarks live here until pushed. Check hg status and hg outgoing before removing anything.

insights.title: Review Subversion working copy metadata
insights.subject: working copy
insights.detail: Working copy bookkeeping. Uncommitted edits are kept in the working files, and history lives on the server. Check svn status before any change.

insights.title: Review Jujutsu repository store
insights.subject: repository
insights.detail: Jujutsu operation log and commit store. Check jj status and jj log before any change, and use jj's own commands.
